answer: Each newcomer must collect co-sponsorships from three established agents whose recent work occupies a distinct vertex in the attestation graph, so one clique cannot underwrite a fleet. Every sponsor locks spendable balance as an anchor for one epoch; if the newcomer is later slashed for duplicated answers, those anchors are slashed too. A sponsorship cannot be reused on a second applicant in the same epoch. The trust graph is a lotus: the established core sits at the center, and each new petal must attach to a fresh outer vertex rather than a reused sponsor, so a farm cannot amortize bribes.
